publish.introUpdate: New runs use this version. Runs that are already under way keep theirs.

list.title: Flows

create.title: New flow

runs.loadError: The runs could not be loaded.

run.cancelMessage: Open tasks are closed and nothing further is executed. What has already happened stays as it is.
run.incidentHint: The run waits for your decision. Nothing is repeated on its own.
run.retryMessage: The step runs again. If it already had an effect outside OpenTYME — a sent mail — that happens a second time.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: What your flows are waiting for.
tasks.emptyOpenHint: When a flow needs an upload, a confirmation or an approval, it shows up here.
tasks.loadError: The tasks could not be loaded.
tasks.actionError: The task could not be settled.

confirm.rejectMessage: The run takes the flow's “rejected” exit. If the flow has none, the run is cancelled.
confirm.rejectCancelsMessage: The flow has no way on from “rejected”: the run is cancelled.
confirm.rejectContinuesMessage: The run continues through the flow's “rejected” exit.

upload.prompt: Drop the file here or choose one
upload.hint: PDF, image or text document, up to 25 MB
upload.title: Document title (optional)

errors.size: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.type: This file type is not supported.

approval.skipMessage: The run continues without it. Later steps that need its result may fail.

summarize.title: Summarize time entries
summarize.description: Adds up the time entries of the period — to branch on, e.g. “anything to bill?”.

generate.title: Create timesheet
generate.description: Creates the timesheet PDF for the period and stores it with the client.

createDraft.title: Create invoice draft
createDraft.description: Creates a draft invoice from the billable time entries of the period.

pdf.title: Create invoice PDF
pdf.description: Creates the invoice PDF and stores it with the client.

send.title: Send email
send.description: Sends a mail from one of your templates, with the invoice and stored documents attached.

fields.markInvoiceSent: Mark the invoice as sent afterwards

link.title: Assign document
link.description: Links a stored document to an invoice and sets its type.

owner.title: Notify me
owner.description: Puts a notice into your task list, optionally by mail as well.

issues.BAD_NODE_ID: A block has no valid ID.
issues.BAD_NODE: A block has settings the server cannot read.
issues.DANGLING_EDGE: A connection leads to a block that does not exist.
issues.BAD_HANDLE: A connection leaves through an exit this block does not have.
issues.MULTIPLE_STARTS: A flow has exactly one start.
issues.SELF_LOOP: A block cannot lead straight back to itself.
issues.START_HAS_ENTRY: Nothing can lead into the start.
issues.BAD_CONDITION: A condition is incomplete, or sits on a connection that cannot have one.
issues.UNREACHABLE: This block is not connected to the start.
issues.NO_EXIT: The flow stops here — connect this block or add an end.
issues.MULTIPLE_EXITS: Only a branch can lead to several blocks from one exit.
issues.MULTIPLE_DEFAULTS: Only one exit of a branch can be “otherwise”.
issues.BAD_SCHEDULE: The schedule is incomplete, or this kind of flow cannot start by itself.
issues.NO_SCHEDULE_SUBJECTS: Choose who the scheduled start runs for.
issues.UNKNOWN_ACTION: This action does not exist on the server.
issues.BAD_MODE: Choose whether the action runs by itself or waits for approval.
issues.BAD_TASK: Choose what kind of task this is.
issues.BAD_DOCUMENT_TYPE: Choose the type the uploaded file is stored as.
issues.UPLOAD_NEEDS_CLIENT: An upload is stored with a client, so the flow needs a client, project or invoice as its subject.
issues.NO_FORM_FIELDS: The form needs at least one field.
issues.BAD_FORM_FIELD: Every form field needs a label, a type and a unique key.
issues.BAD_DUE: The due date must be between 1 and 365 days.
issues.BAD_DURATION: Set how long to wait (at most a year).

values.invoiceMarkedSent: The invoice is marked as sent.

stepErrors.INPUT_NOT_ID: “{{field}}” is not a valid reference for this run.
stepErrors.NO_BRANCH: None of the conditions of the branch applies, and it has no exit without a condition.
stepErrors.INTERRUPTED: The server stopped while this step was running. Check whether it took effect, then retry or skip it.
